_comment: frame-shm TX side (§5.1a/§15.4): the RTP in-stream is fed from a waybeam_venc SHM ring 'venc_frame' (whole encoded frames, [VencFrameMeta][Annex-B]) instead of a UDP socket. The FrameFramer fragments each frame into k source symbols + Cauchy-RS repair per the fec block, then fans DATA out over the air backend (:5801/:5802). NACK returns heard on :5810. Run beside config.frame-shm-rx.sample.json; a venc producer must own the 'venc_frame' ring. For real radios use "kind": "radio".
